jess: Heads up — my PR #4322 is red on the typecheck/format gate after the merge queue run. CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345 :sob:
omar: which job is failing? pre-commit or mypy?
jess: mypy-3.11 on ubuntu-latest. Error snippet:
```
src/runtime/kvcache.py:128: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type 'Optional[bytes]', variable has type 'bytes')
```
liam: hmm that usually comes from a stub or a generated-types change. Did you touch any stubs or proto-generated files?
jess: only a tiny typing tweak in utils.py. Locally `tox -e typecheck` passes. CI shows the failure though — maybe different mypy/install environment or cache.
ana: (typo) sorry meant ana: @ci-bot can you rerun the mypy job for PR 4322? want to see if it's transient.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: Rerun requested by ana — queued (run 12347).
omar: also noticing eslint warnings in a separate PR, wondering if a pre-commit hook ordering change rolled out yesterday. @devex any known changes?
maya: I flipped the pre-commit runner image yesterday to the pinned org image. I didn't intentionally bump hook versions, just the runner env.
liam: if rerun fails, we should bisect between the last green and current HEAD. If rerun passes, probably a transient infra flake.
jess: rerun queued — thanks. If it stays red, can someone with CI access run `git bisect run ./tools/typecheck-bisect.sh` and report the first bad commit? I won't be able to today.
omar: I can take the bisect if rerun fails. tagging me here so I see it. :+1:
jess: thanks everyone :heart:
